# Adding a Machine means adding a row here. No code changes
# update. Edit this file while the game is running and the change applies when
# you save it.
# Columns:
#   id              Identifier. Lowercase letters
#                   and Recipes refer to Machines by this
#                   breaking change; adding one is not.
#   display_name    What the player sees.
#   role            miner   — extracts a Resource from a Node it is placed on.
#                             Its Recipe must have no inputs; the Node is the
#                             input.
#                   crafter — consumes Belt-fed inputs. Its Recipe must have at
#                             least one input and at least one output.
#                   generator — burns a Belt-fed fuel and supplies the one Power
#                             grid. Its Recipe is the fuel and the burn time
#                             must have no outputs
